_about: Shared by core/tests/unit/test_hourly_grid_parity.py and frontend/src/utils/hourlyGridParity.test.js. The request page (utils/rental.js: freeStartTimes, isHourlyPickupDisabled) and the server (Collection.reservation_hour_violation, has_overlap, _day_has_a_free_hour) each decide which hourly starts exist; each case's expectations are worked out by hand in its note, and both suites must agree with them. A Monday throughout (weekday key "0"). now_minutes is the clock on that same day, or null for a day that is not today.

cases.name: two blocks, a two-hour slot, nothing booked
cases.note: Hourly grid from each block's opening: 10,11,12 fit 120 min before 14:00; 16,17,18 before 20:00.

cases.name: a block opening off the hour keeps its own grid
cases.note: The grid runs from 10:20, not from midnight: 10:20, 11:20, 12:20, 13:20 each leave an hour before 14:20.

cases.name: a free hour that sits off the grid is no slot
cases.note: Booked 10:00-10:30 and 11:30-14:00 leave 10:30-11:30 free — sixty minutes, but no start at 10:30 exists on a grid from 10:00, and 11:00 would overlap 11:30.

cases.name: the same gap widened to fit the 11:00 start
cases.note: With the second booking starting at 12:00, 11:00-12:00 is free and on the grid; ending exactly as a booking starts is no clash.

cases.name: today, from the current minute on
cases.note: At 12:01, 12:00 has begun; 13:00 and the afternoon block remain. A start in the current minute would still count — 12:01 is simply not on the grid.

cases.name: today, at the very minute a slot starts
cases.note: At 13:00 exactly, 13:00 has not begun yet — the same rule on both sides.

cases.name: today, once the last start has passed
cases.note: One block 10:00-14:00 on the hour: its last start, 13:00, has begun by 13:30.

cases.name: a whole-day booking closes every hour
cases.note: A booking with no times (a loan, a day-unit reservation) takes the whole day.
